scope: A purposive cross-category sample: 26 crypto identities, three corporate benchmarks and Tumblr. This is not an exhaustive census or a market-share ranking.
method: Official brand guidance, current official sites and browser captures. Observations are design interpretation. Source-access limits are recorded rather than treated as visual verification.

references.name: Coinbase
references.observation: A restrained lowercase wordmark and separate compact mark; the press kit insists on consistent, unaltered use.
references.lesson: Separate wordmark and symbol roles; do not borrow the C/circle vocabulary.
references.evidence: Press text and live Design System wordmark; press page browser challenge.

references.name: Binance
references.observation: A compact diamond arrangement paired with uppercase lettering and a strong yellow signature.
references.lesson: Recognizable silhouette and repetition; avoid nested diamonds.
references.evidence: Official site capture and press source.

references.name: Kraken
references.observation: An arch-like creature symbol accompanies lowercase lettering; the symbol carries personality without a detailed illustration.
references.lesson: A simple character can scale; do not borrow the arch or tentacle rhythm.
references.evidence: Official site capture.

references.name: OKX
references.observation: A high-contrast block-grid wordmark makes geometry part of the name itself.
references.lesson: A consistent construction rule is memorable; avoid checkerboards and pixel crosses.
references.evidence: Official site capture.

references.name: Gemini
references.observation: Interlocking loop geometry accompanies a compact uppercase wordmark in the current header.
references.lesson: Controlled geometry can feel financial; interlocking rings are already heavily occupied.
references.evidence: Official site capture.

references.name: Crypto.com
references.observation: A compact geometric crest and a restrained wordmark support a broad product family.
references.lesson: Consistency across products; avoid a hexagonal badge or animal crest.
references.evidence: Official site capture.

references.name: Bybit
references.observation: An October 2026 official announcement describes turning the orange I from the Bybit wordmark into a standalone brand mark and repeated-line visual system.
references.lesson: A letter can support a full identity system, but extracting Tincta’s t again would preserve the present resemblance concern.
references.evidence: Official press announcement and brand-assets source; local browser capture blocked by HTTP/2 error.

references.name: Bitget
references.observation: Opposing directional forms and a compact wordmark use cyan as a recognizable accent.
references.lesson: A sharp two-part silhouette can be economical; avoid paired exchange arrows.
references.evidence: Official site capture.

references.name: Uniswap
references.observation: The unicorn symbol remains a recognizable sign in the official Labs header; the page links official brand assets.
references.lesson: Own a specific silhouette; a mascot would shift Tincta away from the requested restraint.
references.evidence: Official Labs site capture and brand-kit section; not a conflation of Labs and Protocol marks.

references.name: PancakeSwap
references.observation: A bunny mark and friendly lettering give the trading interface an approachable character.
references.lesson: Warmth can be expressed structurally; Tincta does not need a new character mascot.
references.evidence: Official site capture.

references.name: Sushi
references.observation: The small sushi illustration carries the memorable cue beside simple lettering.
references.lesson: An identifiable object can do the work; avoid food, gaming and novelty cues for this brief.
references.evidence: Official site capture.

references.name: 1inch
references.observation: The current homepage header leads with a compact 1inch wordmark. Older unicorn imagery should not be substituted for this observation.
references.lesson: Audit the live identity instead of assuming a familiar historic symbol is still primary.
references.evidence: Official current homepage capture.

references.name: Curve
references.observation: The official page references its logo in the Curve asset repository; the animated browser capture remained blank/faded.
references.lesson: Exclude Curve from silhouette comparisons until its source asset is inspected.
references.evidence: Official page and asset link; current visual capture incomplete.

references.name: Balancer
references.observation: Stacked elliptical forms create a compact symbol, repeated as larger sculptural forms on the site.
references.lesson: A simple mark can generate a wider visual system; avoid stacked pebble/disc motifs.
references.evidence: Official site capture after a second load.

references.name: Jupiter
references.observation: A small banded planet-like symbol appears in the current interface alongside restrained typography.
references.lesson: Distinct contour rhythm matters more than elaborate detail; avoid a striped planet.
references.evidence: Official site capture.

references.name: Raydium
references.observation: The interface uses an angular geometric emblem with a letter-like center and a multicolor outline.
references.lesson: A monogram can be technical; avoid hexagon framing and depending on gradients.
references.evidence: Official header visible in the site capture; trading disclaimer not accepted.

references.name: dYdX
references.observation: Mixed-case lettering and an emphatic X make the name itself the main identifier.
references.lesson: Distinctive character relationships can replace a separate emblem.
references.evidence: Official site capture.

references.name: Hyperliquid
references.observation: The Foundation landing reveal uses a minimal, fluid two-lobed form in mint against dark green.
references.lesson: Reduction need not mean straight lines; avoid a symmetric liquid/hourglass silhouette.
references.evidence: Official Foundation loading/reveal capture; not a completed trading-interface audit.

references.name: Aave
references.observation: A simplified ghost supports a closely related rounded lowercase wordmark. The brand page explicitly distinguishes logo, wordmark and logomark.
references.lesson: Make the symbol and lettering share a vocabulary; retain one-color integrity.
references.evidence: Official brand page and rendered primary logo.

references.name: Morpho
references.observation: The official guide connects a butterfly-derived symbol with FK Grotesk typography and an institutional design system.
references.lesson: An abstract symbol can have a specific origin; avoid butterfly/wings or the same blue institutional package.
references.evidence: Official guidelines and browser capture.

references.name: Compound
references.observation: The current site uses a small stacked geometric symbol beside a quiet wordmark. The legacy domain now redirects.
references.lesson: Simple geometry scales; verify current domains and assets before making comparisons.
references.evidence: Official current site capture and redirect confirmation.

references.name: Lido
references.observation: A small droplet-like symbol and spaced uppercase name sit apart from the large Ethereum artwork on the page.
references.lesson: Do not confuse product/network artwork with the parent logo; avoid a drop/diamond hybrid.
references.evidence: Official header capture.

references.name: Sky
references.observation: A compact radial symbol accompanies the short Sky name within a purple-led system.
references.lesson: Simple names need distinctive silhouettes; avoid another generic radial sparkle.
references.evidence: Official site capture.

references.name: Ethena
references.observation: The interface uses a restrained circular letter-like emblem and dark, institutional presentation.
references.lesson: Monochrome restraint supports finance; avoid a circular E/coin enclosure.
references.evidence: Official site capture.

references.name: Pendle
references.observation: The identity pairs a compact abstract symbol with spaced lettering. The guide separates logo type (Kyrial), app type (Inter) and media type (Poppins).
references.lesson: The logo can have its own lettering without changing the entire UI font.
references.evidence: Official site capture and brand guide.

references.name: Chainlink
references.observation: A hollow hexagon is paired with a plain wordmark; official assets document spacing and color use.
references.lesson: Consistency can make very simple geometry recognizable; a hexagon would put Tincta in occupied territory.
references.evidence: Official brand page and rendered mark.

references.name: Stripe
references.observation: The compact lowercase wordmark is the stable identifier within a much more expressive surrounding visual system.
references.lesson: Keep the mark simple and let artwork carry color. Avoid imitating Stripe’s cuts or slant.
references.evidence: Official current site capture.

references.name: Mastercard
references.observation: Official guidance distinguishes the standalone symbol from the wordmark-bearing brand mark. Browser access was denied in this environment.
references.lesson: Symbol-only use is a separate identity role, not merely a cropped wordmark.
references.evidence: Official indexed brand guidance; local visual capture incomplete.

references.name: IBM
references.observation: The guide documents different optical treatment for positive and reversed artwork, including bar weight and internal points.
references.lesson: Refinement includes optical masters, clear space and reproducibility, not only a clever idea.
references.evidence: Official design guidance and browser capture.

references.name: Tumblr
references.observation: Tumblr’s wordmark uses a serif lowercase t. Tincta’s current glyph is sans, but the dominant upright, crossbar and right-turning foot create a similar first reading.
references.lesson: Change the compact silhouette, not just the corner radius, color or font weight.
references.evidence: Official site capture plus local canonical Tincta geometry; resemblance is a design judgment.
